title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with pristine clarity but a confusing sound‑check vibe; strong jams like Bird Song and Wharf Rat offset pitch quirks.
ai_review.review: The first reviewer raves about the crystal‑clear soundboard source, recalling how early Dead tapes shaped their love of the band. The second reviewer is less certain – they suspect this is a sound‑check and note odd pitch distortions, yet still praise the wild, free‑form jams that include Bird Song, Big River and Wharf Rat.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 4‑star review highlights excellent recording quality; the other gives a 0‑star rating complaining about sound issues and uncertainty about the source, pulling the average down to roughly a 3‑star level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as having “pristine clarity” by one reviewer; another notes pitch distortions and possible sound‑check ambience, suggesting occasional oddities but overall a clean board mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer mentions an opening with "Promised" (likely “Promised Land”) and closing with "Around" (probably “Around and Around”), plus a long, free‑form jam that drifts through Bird Song, Wharf Rat and other themes.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir is praised for ‘blazing the lyrics’ during his vocal sections.
